zh: 天主教辅仁大学（英语译名：Fu Jen Catholic University），通称辅仁大学、辅大（FJCU、FJU），是位于台湾新北市新庄区的天主教大学，同时是华语世界唯一的宗座大学 ，为台湾各所天主教会兴办之大专院校中唯一直属圣座（罗马教廷）管辖者. 最早历史可追溯至1925年圣座委托本笃会在中国大陆北京建校，1933年由圣言会接办，至1952年被中共政府并入北京师范大学；之后在1961年由教宗若望二十三世任命南京总主教于斌联合圣言会、耶稣会、台湾主教团（校方称为「中国圣职单位」）等3个教会单位合作在台复校，并于1963年启用新庄现址. 2013年与基隆市圣心高中、圣心小学合并为单一学校法人机构，辅仁大学则成为该法人下属学校之一. 现设有12个学院、进修部，以及附设医院、天主教学术院等附属机构.

辅大学生总数达2万5千人 ，是台湾规模最大的大专院校之一. 参与创始亚洲博雅、欧盟七校、清华五校联盟，主掌UMAP秘书处，亦拥有全台最初AACSB及IFT认证、A&HCI期刊 与职业级体育校队群. 跻身亚洲3大天主教大学 、交协台湾7大名门大学之一. 辅大创校迄今已百周年，在台复校逾60年，校友近20万人遍及全球社会各界，涵盖阁揆、大法官、立法委员、富比世富豪等名流，3名中央研究院院士 、学者、艺文名人、奥运及各级体育赛事选手.
天主教大学具有「圣座设立」、「修道会或教区设立」的差异，辅仁大学为两者兼具之特例.
辅仁大学遵循《天主教大学宪章》、《天主教法典》第807条「以严谨、批判的态度，藉著研究、教学与服务，来维护人类尊严和文化传承」 ，在中华民国《大学法》之外另订「大学宗旨」摘要如下 ： * 1) 致力于中华文化与基督信仰之交融. * 2) 献身于学术研究与弘扬真理. * 3) 促使社会均衡发展及增进人类福祉.
辅仁大学的校名由近代中国教育家、天主教徒英敛之所定，源自《论语·颜渊》书中曾子的格言：「君子以文会友，以友辅仁」. 其意指「藉学问集合同志朋友，共同发挥仁道精神」. 英译校名经常省略「天主教」（Catholic）字眼，使用FJCU、FJU两种缩写. 中文全衔有： * 的法定校名 ：天主教辅仁大学. * 中华民国教育部的登记校名 ：辅仁大学学校财团法人辅仁大学.
en: Fu Jen Catholic University (FJU, FJCU or Fu Jen; or ) is a private Catholic university in Xinzhuang, New Taipei City, Taiwan. The university was founded in 1925 in Beijing at the request of Pope Pius XI and re-established in Taiwan in 1961 at the request of Pope John XXIII.

Fu Jen has consists of twelve colleges and schools, among which are several of Taiwan's first or only academic units in Italian language, info-management, museology, religious studies, philosophy. The campus is served by Fu Jen University Station, Taiwan's first metro station named after a university.

Fu Jen is the oldest Catholic and Jesuit-affiliated institution of higher education in the Sinophone world, under the direct authority of the Congregation for Catholic Education of the Holy See. It is also a non-state actor of Track II diplomacy in the Holy See–Taiwan relations. Therefore, Fu Jen has special importance internationally and is known for its strong ties with the Roman Curia. In the past nearly one hundred years of history, the Benedictine, the Verbites, and the Jesuits from all over the world have participated in the management of the university.

The university has the nation's first business school there with AACSB accreditation and also the medical college was the earliest to promote PBL as pedagogy for medical education. Fu Jen alumni include Premier Lin Chuan, former First Lady of China Wang Guangmei, and politicians in the Legislative Yuan.

The institution was originally established in Beijing in 1925 by the Benedictines of St. Vincent Archabbey in Latrobe, Pennsylvania, at the request of the Holy See, with Archabbot Aurelius Stehle serving as chancellor. Fu Jen, then commonly known as the Catholic University of Peking, was itself a successor to the Fu Jen Academy, which was created through the efforts of Catholic scholars Ma Xiangbo and Ying Lianzhi. The university's first president (1925–1927) was the American missionary George Barry O'Toole, OSB. He was succeeded by Chen Yuan, a Chinese Protestant and renowned historian, who remained university president until the school's forced closure by the Chinese Communist government in 1952.
